Figures \(0,\) \(1,\) \(2,\) and \(3\) consist of \(1,\) \(5,\) \(13,\) and \(25\) nonoverlapping unit squares, respectively. If the pattern were continued, how many nonoverlapping unit squares would there be in figure \(100?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

A circle centered at \(O\) has radius \(1\) and contains the point \(A.\) Segment \(AB\) is tangent to the circle at \(A\) and \(\angle AOB = \theta.\) If point \(C\) lies on \(\overline{OA}\) and \(BC\) bisects \(\angle ABO,\) then what is \(OC?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

The graph below shows a portion of the curve defined by the quartic polynomial \[P(x) = x^4 + ax^3 + bx^2 + cx + d.\] Which of the following is the smallest?

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

choices.B: The product of the zeros of \(P\)
choices.C: The product of the non-real zeros of \(P\)
choices.D: The sum of the coefficients of \(P\)
choices.E: The sum of the real zeros of \(P\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

mappings.rationale: Tangency makes OAB a right triangle. Trigonometric side relationships determine OC using either the angle-bisector side ratio or equal perpendicular distances from C to BA and BO.
mappings.answerReason: Let x = OC, so CA = 1 - x. Since OB = 1/cos θ and AB = sin θ/cos θ, the angle-bisector theorem gives x/(1 - x) = OB/AB = 1/sin θ. Thus x = 1/(1 + sin θ). The distance route gives the same equation as 1 - x = x sin θ.

mappings.derivedAnswer: C. The product of the non-real zeros of P
mappings.answerReason: The graph shows real zeros r = 2 and 3 < s < 4, with 4 < d = P(0) < 6. Therefore the non-real pair has product d/(rs), which lies between 0 and 1. The other choices are P(-1) > 3, d > 4, P(1) > 2, and r + s > 5.

mappings.rationale: The arc-center conditions make ABC equilateral. Use its 60° arc length to find the common radius, then express internal tangency through center distances and apply the Pythagorean theorem.
mappings.answerReason: Let R = AB and let the smaller radius be r. Arc BC has length πR/3 = 12. The smaller center is r above the midpoint of AB and is R - r from A, so (R/2)² + r² = (R - r)². Hence r = 3R/8 and its circumference is 2πr = 3πR/4 = 27.
